A comparison table titled "Mercury 3: Benchmark results vs. models in its class" comparing three AI models: Mercury 3 (Medium), GPT-6 Luna (Medium), and Claude Haiku 5.5 (Medium).
Speed & Cost
 * Output speed (tokens/s): Mercury 3 leads at 1,068, compared to ~130 for GPT-6 Luna and ~240 for Claude Haiku 5.5.
 * Price ($/M, in / out): Mercury 3 is $0.10 / $0.35, while both GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 are $0.10 / $0.50.
Capabilities
 * GDPval-AA v2 (Elo): Mercury 3 (1,237.2), GPT-6 Luna (1,204.0), Claude Haiku 5.5 (1,225.0).
 * \tau^3-bench Banking: Mercury 3 (30.24), GPT-6 Luna (23.00), Claude Haiku 5.5 (13.06).
 * MultiChallenge: Mercury 3 (60.35), GPT-6 Luna (51.49), Claude Haiku 5.5 (52.48).
 * AA-Omniscience (accuracy): Mercury 3 (46.44), GPT-6 Luna leads at 46.94, Claude Haiku 5.5 (37.22).
 * IFBench: Mercury 3 (76.84), GPT-6 Luna (61.82), Claude Haiku 5.5 (54.65).
 * GPQA Diamond: Mercury 3 (89.23), GPT-6 Luna (86.36), Claude Haiku 5.5 (84.51).
Long Context
 * AA-LCR v1.1: Mercury 3 (77.67), GPT-6 Luna leads at 78.30, Claude Haiku 5.5 (74.70).
 * MRCR v2: Mercury 3 (75.50), GPT-6 Luna (62.72), Claude Haiku 5.5 leads at 78.40.
Agentic Coding
 * SWE-Bench Atlas: Mercury 3 (51.08), GPT-6 Luna (33.33), Claude Haiku 5.5 (32.26).
 * DeepSWE v1: Mercury 3 (46.31), GPT-6 Luna (37.76), Claude Haiku 5.5 leads at 51.62.
Agentic Search
 * BrowseComp+: Mercury 3 (55.18), GPT-6 Luna (50.50), Claude Haiku 5.5 (45.78).
 * DeepSearchQA: Mercury 3 (71.33), GPT-6 Luna (60.00), Claude Haiku 5.5 (65.22).
